authority: Executable classification of the legacy LegacyEngine/ChonkCraft attack-move diagnostic suite; these names may remain red only while the BNE player/referee lane passes.

classified_failures.name: aBlockedChaseDoesNotReplanWhenFastCountsDownToZero
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts the upstream PathFinderOutput Fast countdown; BNE refusal cadence is owned by the authenticated refusal-machine and movement gates.

classified_failures.name: anOpeningScanServesSpentOutputAlreadyAimedAtItsTarget
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts the upstream spent-output service beat rather than the BNE opening acquisition transition.

classified_failures.name: simplifiedTargetingDoesNotLetThresholdSuppressAttackBack
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts LegacyEngine HitUnit_AttackBack behavior; BNE retaliation is certified by the combat and idle-targeting systems.

classified_failures.name: aReachedDyingGoalStillBuysTheCommittedSwing
classified_failures.disposition: Cycle-exact dying-goal swing timing belongs to the authenticated combat/death precision lane, not the player attack-move contract.

classified_failures.name: aBlockedArrivalRestoresTheSavedAttackOrder
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream COrder/SavedOrder restoration internals; BNE obstruction recovery is observed end to end by the player referee.

classified_failures.name: aBroadsideStartsAtTheWiggledShipNotOnlyItsTile
classified_failures.disposition: Sub-tile broadside origin is owned by projectile and movement precision evidence, not order completion.

classified_failures.name: aStandingAutoAttackReplacesAnOlderSavedMove
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts replacement of an upstream SavedOrder object that the BNE order model does not use.

classified_failures.name: aGoalLessRefusalSpendsTheMoveArmsSecondScan
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts a LegacyEngine second-scan beat; BNE refused-step control flow is covered by the transcribed refusal machine.

classified_failures.name: aFreshAcquisitionSpendsTheMoveArmsSecondScanOnARefusal
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts a LegacyEngine second-scan beat after acquisition rather than a BNE player-visible outcome.

classified_failures.name: aChaserCanReachItsTargetWhileSharingGroundWithADyingBody
classified_failures.disposition: Dying-body occupancy is owned by the authenticated movement/occupancy lane.

classified_failures.name: theSameMarchServesTheDeadChaseBlockedStepWait
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream PF_WAIT bookkeeping after a dead chase; BNE recovery is certified by complete-loop movement and attack-move referees.

classified_failures.name: aLiveQuarryThatEscapesReactionRangeRestoresTheSavedPost
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts restoration through the upstream SavedOrder object rather than BNE's position-order fields.

classified_failures.name: anAiHitAfterGoalDeathUpdatesTheAttackOrdersGoalPosition
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts LegacyEngine AI HitUnit_AttackBack goal mutation; BNE AI reaction is owned by retail-AI and combat lanes.

classified_failures.name: aNewAttackMoveDoesNotOverwriteAnUnbreakableChaseStep
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream order-object overwrite rules during an animation boundary, not the BNE command outcome.

classified_failures.name: anAiAttackOrderHandlesAHitFromItsExistingFight
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts the upstream AI hit callback; BNE fight continuation is owned by combat and retail-AI referees.

classified_failures.name: aFreshBlockedArrivalKeepsTheUnitPathOutput
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts preservation of upstream PathFinderOutput state; BNE route/refusal state has separate authenticated coverage.

classified_failures.name: anAutomaticAttackCapturesTheScanTimeTile
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts the upstream SavedOrder tile snapshot representation rather than the BNE stored position-order contract.

classified_failures.name: aChaseWakeReplansBeforeTheDirectRangeCheck
classified_failures.disposition: Cycle ordering between route replanning and range checking belongs to the precision net.

classified_failures.name: aRestoredMarchKeepsTheRemainingRoute
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream SavedOrder plus route-buffer restoration internals; the BNE referee observes resumed visible progress.

classified_failures.name: underAttackDefersTheSavedOrderAtPfWaitArrival
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream SavedOrder behavior at PF_WAIT, a state pair absent from the BNE order model.

classified_failures.name: aStandingUnitReturnsToAnAttackMoveAtThePostItLeft
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream COrder/SavedOrder restoration; the BNE retail referee directly certifies kill-and-resume.

classified_failures.name: anInRangeRetargetDoesNotEraseTheCachedRoute
classified_failures.disposition: Cached-route preservation during retargeting is owned by target-selection and route precision evidence.

classified_failures.name: aRestoredMarchAfterTheLastStepDoesNotKeepChasing
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts upstream last-step SavedOrder state; BNE completion is certified by destination arrival.

classified_failures.name: anAutomaticAttackStoresTwoAttackMoveDestinations
classified_failures.disposition: Asserts two upstream attack-move destination copies; BNE uses its authenticated position-order representation.
